blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Las Piñas Rep. Mark Anthony Santos has endorsed the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency’s (PDEA) request to the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) for the creation of a national task force to intensify the crackdown against illegal drugs. According to Santos on Sunday, the recent reports that a Filipino allegedly smuggled 521 kilograms of suspected methamphetamine from Laos bound for the Philippines underscore the need to establish a National Anti-Illegal Drug Task Force. Foreign authorities said that the Filipino passenger was believed to be aboard a private jet booked for US$49,500 or P3.1 million. READ: BARMM politicians, […]...
